intro.title: AEON — YOUR AGENT IN THE CLOUD
intro.body: Aeon is your agent working for you in the cloud, even when this app is closed. It lives in your own GitHub fork ({{owner}}/aeon) and runs skills — research, monitoring, writing — autonomously via GitHub Actions, on a schedule or whenever you dispatch a task. Results land in Recent runs below and in any channel you connect (Telegram, Discord, Slack, email).

channels.header: Channels · how Aeon talks to you
channels.intro: Aeon natively supports these — just push the secret(s) and the workflow activates the channel on the next run. No workflow patching required.

toast.pushed: {{channel}} secrets pushed — channel active on next skill run

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.description: Most popular channel — Aeon sends skill outputs as messages and you can reply with commands. Create a bot with @BotFather, then send /start to your bot from your account.

discord-webhook.label: Discord (outbound only)
discord-webhook.description: Easiest Discord setup — push-only. Channel → Edit Channel → Integrations → Webhooks → Create. No bot permissions needed.

discord-bot.label: Discord (inbound + outbound)
discord-bot.description: Full two-way Discord. discord.com/developers → New Application → Bot → enable Message Content intent, copy bot token. Invite bot to your server with channels:history scope.

slack-webhook.label: Slack (outbound only)
slack-webhook.description: Push-only Slack. api.slack.com → Your Apps → Create New App → From scratch → Incoming Webhooks → Add to channel → copy URL.

slack-bot.label: Slack (inbound + outbound)
slack-bot.description: Full two-way Slack. App → OAuth & Permissions → add channels:history + reactions:write scopes → install → copy Bot User OAuth Token. Channel ID is in the URL.

email.label: Email (SendGrid)
email.description: Skill outputs arrive as styled HTML emails. sendgrid.com/settings/api_keys → Create API Key with Mail Send permission → copy. Set the recipient address you want notifications sent to.
